text:
Nikhil (Product): quick follow-up from todayall-hands about pricing/limits can we lock down the rules for rollover + ratecap behavior?
Sam (Finance): TL;DR: trial credits expire end of trial (no rollover). paid customers: carry up to 25% of monthly credits for one additional month. enterprise contracts can define custom terms via SOW.
Nikhil (Product): automatic or opt-in for paid customers?
Sam (Finance): automatic. opt-in only applies to bespoke enterprise credit packages.
Maya (Eng): enforcement question: what happens when a token request arrives and account has exhausted monthly + rollover? throttle? error?
Iris (Support): current plan: soft-throttle using burst buffer for short spikes, then 429 once buffer drained. docs will include exact 429 payload we return.
Maya (Eng): sample 429 we plan to return (for console copy / SDK docs):
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "message": "Monthly credits exhausted. Burst buffer applied.",
  "retry_after_seconds": 30
}
Nikhil (Product): good. include a human-friendly line for console: "You've used all monthly credits. Retry in 30s or upgrade to Dedicated."
Ava (CEO): simple customer messaging is key: "Trial credits do not roll over. Paid credits can roll over up to 25% for one month. Rolled-over credits expire after 30 days." Put that in the marketing FAQ.
Iris (Support): will we support per-category buckets (generation vs embeddings) so customers can reserve quotas?
Sam (Finance): roadmap: Q3 we ship per-product buckets with default splits. customers can request reallocation via support. Enterprise customers can set fixed allocations in SOW.
Maya (Eng): engineering note: burst buffer implemented as token bucket with 2x burst capacity and a 60s refill smoothing window. we'll add metrics for burst usage.
Nikhil (Product): what about internal sandboxes and demo orgs? mirror trial or give special rules?
Ava (CEO): special-case internal SSO groups: flag 'redwood-internal' to get higher monthly allotment and 50% rollover. Demo orgs remain trial-like.
quota-bot: Reminder: update /docs/usage-policies and /console/credits-blurb by 2026-04-08. Owner: @Nikhil.
Iris (Support): I'll draft the support FAQ and canned responses for 429s.
Sam (Finance): operational note: if a customer constantly uses burst we should surface a billing suggestion to move to Dedicated or Reserved.
Maya (Eng): action: PR for burst algorithm + docs link next week.
Nikhil (Product): I'll make a one-pager and add a tiny diagram for the all-hands recap email.
Ava (CEO): thanks everyone. flag any SLA tradeoffs ASAP. :thumbsup:
